pick.counterargument: The honest counterargument is the sample: this process has not been shown to work, and a single ranking position is not evidence about one company.
invalidation: Quarterly revenue growth falling below +0.8%, the rate it was running at the quarter before.
Cash conversion dropping below 1.0×, meaning earnings stop being backed by cash.
A close below the 200-session average, which stood at $20.06 on the decision date.
risks: The most recent filing covers a period ending 2026-06-30, 114 days before the decision date.
One of the four quarters in the trailing year is the fourth quarter, which companies report only as part of the full year; it is derived as the annual figure less the first three quarters.
Point-in-time fundamentals are built from filings accepted up to 2026-10-22.

earnings.basis: the same fiscal quarter's announcement a year earlier (2025-11-05) plus 364 days

pick.rule: Universe: every US-listed common stock on NYSE, Nasdaq or NYSE American — about 4,700 names from Nasdaq Trader's own file. Eligible means: priced at $5 or more, median daily turnover of $20M or more over 60 sessions, at least 253 sessions of history, a 10-Q or 10-K whose period ended within 200 days, close above the 200-session average, volatility inside the day's 85th percentile, debt no more than 6× operating cash flow, no results announced in the last 2 sessions, and no position already open in the stock or a fourth in the same SIC division. Eligible candidates are then ranked on equally weighted z-scores within their sector group, over the signals that are defined for that group. One position per session, held 21 sessions, a twenty-first of capital each, 10 basis points of cost each way. Fundamentals are read as they stood on the decision date, never as they read today. The score is a ranking position among that day's eligible candidates. It is not a probability, a price target, or a forecast of any return.
pick.validation: The held-out window has not been opened. No claim of an edge is made or implied.

stories.title: Updated Google privacy policy says your Gmail might be used for advertising
stories.excerpt: Turning on Personal Intelligence gives the company more data for ad targeting.
stories.lead: Using Google’s products and services has always been fundamentally precarious—doing so gives the world’s largest advertising company a lot of juicy personal data. Google has long said it won’t use the sensitive data from products like Gmail, Drive, and Photos for ad personalization, but a change to the company’s privacy policy appears to dismantle that firewall.

stories.title: NumPy Tutorial: Your First Steps Into Data Science in Python
stories.excerpt: Follow this NumPy tutorial to learn how to create and manipulate arrays in Python and take your first steps into data science.
stories.lead: NumPy is a Python library that provides a simple yet powerful data structure: the n-dimensional array. This is the foundation on which almost all the power of Python’s data science toolkit is built, and learning NumPy is the first step on any Python data scientist’s journey. This tutorial will provide you with the knowledge you need to use NumPy and the higher-level libraries that rely on it.

stories.title: Quiz: Using Pydantic to Simplify Python Data Validation

stories.lead:
In this quiz, you’ll test your understanding of Using Pydantic to Simplify Python Data Validation.

By working through this quiz, you’ll revisit how Pydantic models validate and coerce data, how to customize fields with Field, when to reach for validators, how to validate function arguments with @validate_call, and how to manage settings with pydantic-settings.

The quiz contains 8 questions and there is no time limit. You’ll get 1 point for each correct answer. At the end of the quiz, you’ll receive a total score. The maximum score is 100%. Good luck!

stories.title: Is your Medicare Advantage plan ending next year? Here's what to know
stories.excerpt: Medicare open enrollment runs through Dec. 7, and for as many as 5 million seniors, it will be important to log on and pick a new plan.
stories.lead:
A slew of Medicare Advantage plans are disappearing for next year, leaving seniors in many areas with fewer options. In 193 counties across the country, no plans are offered at all.

Medicare's annual open enrollment period kicked off October 15 and runs until December 7, and seniors enrolled in those privatized Medicare plans that are closing in certain markets should carefully review their options.

stories.title: Arrest made after fire at Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat
stories.excerpt: Around 200 emergency personnel are deployed to fight the blaze at the Nazi dictator's Alpine residence in Germany.
stories.lead:
Completed by the Nazis in 1938, the Eagle's Nest, which sits at an elevation of around 1,800m (5,900ft), escaped destruction after their defeat in 1945.

Since then, it has become a popular tourist destination and houses a mountain inn.

It serves as "a cautionary reminder of the abysses of the inhumane Nazi dictatorship", according to its official website, external.

stories.title: Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits
stories.excerpt: The slowed Starlink connections had affected the Ukraine's military and drone operations for a week.
stories.lead:
Ukraine now has a "stable connection" to Starlink, its defence minister has said, after its military suffered days of restricted connectivity on the satellite network.

Kyiv relies on the Starlink and its military-grade counterpart Starshield for piloting drones and operations within Ukraine, but last week accused US President Donald Trump of telling owner Elon Musk to place limits on it.

This meant drones would lose connection when travelling at 161km/h (100mph) or more, it said. Trump denied doing so before saying Musk had "put it back".

stories.title: This decade has been missing its big-impact midterm
stories.excerpt: Every other decade over the past hundred years has produced at least one midterm that made a big difference in Congress and in national politics more broadly.
stories.lead:
Given all that's happened in American politics since 2019, it may be hard to believe there's been anything missing.

But the decade of the 2020s has yet to see a midterm that mattered much — or that ranked among the impact midterms of past decades.

stories.title: Moody's holds France's credit rating steady despite budget and political uncertainty
stories.excerpt: Defying the forecasts of many economists, the American credit rating agency maintained France's sovereign debt rating at Aa3 on Friday, setting itself apart from the harsher assessments of France's creditworthiness by S&P and Fitch.

stories.title: At a Texas high school football game, fans offer a glimpse into evolving politics
stories.excerpt: We talk with voters at a Texas high school football game at the tailgate, in line at the concession booth and in the stands to hear about the issues that matter to Texans this cycle.
stories.lead:
Texas and football - a classic combination no matter who you root for.

DETROW: Root for or vote for. Texas has been a safe Republican state for three decades, but polling suggests next month's midterms could be tight. So Houston Public Media's Bianca Seward takes us to the bleachers at Deer Park High School's homecoming game, where fans in this Houston suburb offer a glimpse into the state's changing politics.

Little Stars, which gives away free essentials to families in need, has launched Santa's Little Stars, which runs from Saturday 24 October to Friday 4 December.

The public is asked to donate new, unwrapped toys and gifts to donation points in Shrewsbury's Darwin shopping centre.

stories.title: UK to invest £100m in 'world first' AI Biosecurity Lab
stories.excerpt: The chancellor will unveil AI spending aimed at shoring up the UK's defences in Wednesday's Budget.
stories.lead:
The UK says it will establish a national AI Biosecurity Lab (AIBL) to help strengthen its defences against emerging biological threats.

As part of Wednesday's Budget, the government will commit £100m to establishing the new, "world first" institute with the support of leading AI firms.

The chancellor will also pledge millions of pounds in spending across a range of initiatives aimed at shoring up the UK's ability to respond to evolving cyber, biological and AI-enabled threats.

stories.title: Title holder keeps perfect record
stories.excerpt: The eighth round of the Premier VRL League has been completed. In the final match, held at the Banjica pool in Belgrade, Radnicki defeated Partizan 12:8 […] The post Title holder keeps perfect record appeared first on Total Waterpolo .
stories.lead:
In the final match, held at the Banjica pool in Belgrade, Radnicki defeated Partizan 12:8 to maintain a perfect record. The team from Kragujevac secured the win during the third quarter.

Partizan entered the match against the favorites without fear, taking a 2:0 lead within the first three minutes. However, Radnicki then kept their defense “locked down” for nearly nine minutes, staging a turnaround with a 4:0 run. Partizan managed to level the score at 4:4, but the visiting team’s captain Andrija Prlainovic gave Radnicki a narrow 5:4 lead heading into the third period.
